name: Ledger CLI feature drill: dedupe, quarantine, missing-record loudness, expand-pages, epub rendering, initials, name-fold, render, check
purpose: Deterministic drill of every evidence-ledger.py feature against inline fixtures (no skill run, no network dependency beyond optional verify): secondary-id dedupe, merge quarantine, loud [MISSING record] with non-zero exit, --expand-pages arithmetic, epub locator-less rendering, Vancouver initials incl. group-author passthrough, biomcp name->title fold, the cite-key render subcommand (numbering, prose passthrough, hard-fail contract), and the check validity gate. The same matrix runs hermetically in CI via selftest; this case observes the features through the real agent-driven CLI.
prompt:
Work in a fresh subdirectory `evdrill/`. Execute each numbered command in its OWN Bash tool call (no chaining), then paste ALL outputs verbatim in one fenced code block in your FINAL message, ending with the line 'DRILL DONE'. Script path: python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py

First create the fixture files exactly as follows (one Bash call or Write tool):
- evdrill/a.jsonl containing this single line:
  {"schema":"bioresearcher-evidence/1","key":"pmid:21639808","type":"article","ids":{"pmid":"21639808","doi":"10.1056/nejmoa1103782","pmcid":"PMC3549296"},"title":"Improved survival with vemurafenib in melanoma with BRAF V600E mutation","authors":["Chapman Paul B","Hauschild Axel","Robert Caroline","BRIM-3 Investigators"],"journal":"N Engl J Med","year":"2011","volume":"364","issue":"26","pages":"2507-16","verified":false,"backfilled":[],"provenance":[{"aspect":"drill","tool":"fixture"}]}
- evdrill/b.jsonl containing this single line (same DOI, different pmid - must merge into the first record via secondary-id dedupe):
  {"schema":"bioresearcher-evidence/1","type":"article","ids":{"pmid":"99991111","doi":"10.1056/NEJMoa1103782"},"title":null,"provenance":[{"aspect":"drill2","tool":"fixture"}]}
- evdrill/c.jsonl containing exactly two lines: a valid article record with key pmid:42487519, ids {"pmid":"42487519","doi":"10.1111/cas.70480"}, title "New Treatment Strategy and Future Research Direction for BRAF-Mutated Cancer", authors ["Takahashi Masanobu","Taniguchi Sakura Hiraide"], journal "Cancer Sci", year "2026", volume/issue/pages null, verified false, provenance [{"aspect":"drill","tool":"fixture"}] - followed by this malformed second line: not json at all
- evdrill/d.jsonl containing this single line (biomcp drug_get shape: `name`, no `title` - the name must fold into title):
  {"schema":"bioresearcher-evidence/1","type":"drug","ids":{"chembl":"CHEMBL1229517"},"name":"vemurafenib","meta":{"indication":"BRAF V600E-mutant melanoma"},"provenance":[{"aspect":"drill","tool":"fixture"}]}
- evdrill/draft.md containing exactly:
  Vemurafenib [@chembl:CHEMBL1229517] with survival data [@pmid:21639808]. Prose bracket [@home] stays verbatim. Group [@pmid:42487519; @doi:10.1056/NEJMoa1103782].
- evdrill/bad.draft.md containing exactly:
  Broken cite [@pmid:99999999].

Commands (each its own Bash call):
1. evidence-ledger.py add evdrill/a.jsonl '<the a.jsonl record JSON again>'
2. evidence-ledger.py add evdrill/b.jsonl '<the b.jsonl record JSON again>'
3. evidence-ledger.py merge -o evdrill/sources.jsonl 'evdrill/*.jsonl'   (expect the malformed c.jsonl line quarantined to evdrill/_invalid.jsonl)
4. evidence-ledger.py stats evdrill/sources.jsonl   (expect 3 records: pmid:21639808, pmid:42487519, chembl:CHEMBL1229517 - the doi twin merged)
5. evidence-ledger.py bib evdrill/sources.jsonl --keys pmid:21639808,pmid:nope   (expect a [MISSING record pmid:nope] line and a non-zero exit; run `echo exit=$?` as part of the SAME Bash call immediately after)
6. evidence-ledger.py bib evdrill/sources.jsonl --keys pmid:21639808 --expand-pages   (expect pages expanded to 2507-2516)
7. evidence-ledger.py bib evdrill/sources.jsonl --keys pmid:42487519   (epub record: locator-less render - Cancer Sci. 2026. DOI: ... PMID: ...; authors as Takahashi M, Taniguchi SH; Chapman PB-style initials on the other record)
8. evidence-ledger.py add evdrill/d.jsonl '<the d.jsonl record JSON again>'   (expect the banner to echo 'derived keys: chembl:CHEMBL1229517')
9. evidence-ledger.py check evdrill/d.jsonl   (expect '1 record(s) ... quarantined 0; OK' and the chembl key listed; exit 0)
10. evidence-ledger.py render evdrill/sources.jsonl evdrill/draft.md -o evdrill/final.md   (expect '[@home]' untouched, chembl numbered [1], pmid:21639808 numbered [2], and the group as [2, 3] - the doi twin resolves to the same pmid record; appended '## References' with entries [1]-[3] where [1] starts 'vemurafenib.' - the name-fold)
11. evidence-ledger.py render evdrill/sources.jsonl evdrill/bad.draft.md -o evdrill/bad.md; echo exit=$?   (same Bash call: expect non-zero exit, 'unknown citation key pmid:99999999', and evdrill/bad.md NOT created)
12. evidence-ledger.py render evdrill/sources.jsonl evdrill/final.md -o evdrill/double.md; echo exit=$?   (same Bash call: double-render guard - non-zero exit, no markers left; evdrill/double.md NOT created)

checks.desc: one Bash call per numbered command is mandated by the prompt (>=10 of the 12)
quarantine file surfaced in the pasted output
Vancouver initials computed from full names
non-zero exit for the unknown-key bib reported
add echoes the derived canonical key for the name-bearing drug record
check validity gate passes on the clean name-fold ledger
render numbered every marker from the merged ledger
name-fold rendered the drug bibliography entry from `name` (no [MISSING field: title])
render hard-fail loudness on unresolved keys
prose bracket passes through verbatim (not treated as a citation)
